knowledge-preview.title: Published knowledge preview
knowledge-preview.boundary: The original published body and current selection eligibility are separate. Selection only adds this exact reference to the current form; it does not publish, dispatch or start work.
knowledge-preview.invalid_read: The published preview does not match the project, reference or published revision.
knowledge-preview.state.loading: Reading the exact published revision and current eligibility…
knowledge-preview.state.current: This exact published reference is currently eligible for selection.
knowledge-preview.state.publication_chan: The current publication changed. This historical revision is retained for reading; select a current reference separately.
knowledge-preview.state.retired: This knowledge was retired. Its historical body remains readable, and new selection is blocked.
knowledge-preview.state.source_changed: The source changed or is no longer eligible. This historical body is retained, and new selection is blocked.
knowledge-preview.state.unavailable: This reference or its current eligibility could not be verified. Read the original reference again.
knowledge-preview.state.stale: The refresh failed. Previously read text is retained for reference; selection is paused until a successful current read.
knowledge-preview.state.denied: Current access is unavailable. Protected body and sources have been cleared.
